

```{r}
#class({{pair_number}})
```

```{r}
current_pair <- pairs %>%
   filter(pair_number == {{pair_number}})
```

```{r}
current_vars <- pairs %>%   
  filter(pair_number == {{pair_number}}) %>%
  select(V1, V2) %>%
  colnames()
```

```{r}
V1 <- pairs %>%
   filter(pair_number == {{pair_number}}) %>%
   pull(V1) 
 
V2 <- pairs %>%
  filter(pair_number == {{pair_number}}) %>%
  pull(V2) 
```

```{r}
V1_V2 <- paste0(V1, " and ", V2)
my_title <- paste0("Pairwise t-test between ",V1_V2)
 
dt <- input_parameters_raw %>% 
   select(all_of(c(V1, V2))) %>%
   tidyr::pivot_longer(everything()) 

t_test_result <- t.test(value ~ name, data = dt) %>%
   broom::tidy()
```
\pagebreak
## between `r V1` and `r V2`
```{r, fig.cap = my_title}
#| label: fig-{{pair_number}}

dt %>%
   ggplot(aes(x=name, y=value, fill= name)) +
   geom_boxplot() +
   labs(
     title = my_title,
     caption = paste0("t-test p-value = ", round(t_test_result$p.value,2))
     )
```
